human_material_or_model: 262 lung samples from 34 ex-smokers spanning normal lung function and GOLD 1, 2, and 4
assay_resolution: Single-cell atlas integrated with terminal-bronchiole morphology and tissue imaging
disease_comparison: COPD severity series versus ex-smokers with normal lung function
key_expression_result: Cellular states and gene programs were associated with terminal-bronchiole reduction; the study directly links airway pathology to cell-resolved molecular states
evidence_class: Observational disease expression plus orthogonal tissue phenotyping
perturbation_or_validation: Morphology, micro-CT, extracellular-matrix imaging, and transcriptomics were integrated
composition_interpretation: Cell-type abundance and within-cell-state expression are separately measurable, but both can track tissue destruction
principal_limitations: Cross-sectional and enriched for surgically or transplant-derived tissue; association does not prove that a state causes bronchiole loss

phenotype_scope: COPD heterogeneity plus lung function, emphysema, and symptom traits
assay_resolution: Single-nucleus RNA-seq and spatial analysis; 1,516,727 nuclei
disease_comparison: COPD and reference lungs across heterogeneous clinical phenotypes
key_expression_result: Shifts in cell composition and emergent cellular states correlated with lung function, emphysema, and composite symptom scores
perturbation_or_validation: Large-cohort internal replication and spatial localization
composition_interpretation: Composition shifts and within-state programs are distinct outputs and should not be collapsed into a bulk COPD signature
principal_limitations: Trait correlations do not by themselves establish COPD-causal genes; some signals may track emphysema or severity

phenotype_scope: COPD status plus spirometric impairment and emphysema concordance
human_material_or_model: Bronchial epithelial brushings from 238 current and former smokers
assay_resolution: Bulk expression in an epithelial-enriched brushing
disease_comparison: Smokers with versus without COPD, with continuous FEV1 percent predicted and FEV1/FVC
key_expression_result: Ninety-eight genes were jointly associated with COPD status and both lung-function measures; the signature was concordant with distal-lung and emphysema datasets
perturbation_or_validation: ATF4 overexpression in airway epithelial cells recapitulated the COPD-associated direction of the gene set; an independent inhaled-corticosteroid cohort showed partial reversibility
composition_interpretation: Brushing enriches airway epithelium but residual subtype-composition differences can affect bulk expression
principal_limitations: The 98 genes are not COPD-exclusive because selection required association with lung function; ATF4 perturbation supports pathway control, not disease causation

phenotype_scope: Smoking-dependent airway remodeling with COPD subgroup
human_material_or_model: Small-airway epithelial brushings from healthy nonsmokers, healthy smokers, and smokers with COPD; basal-cell air-liquid-interface model
assay_resolution: Bulk epithelial-enriched expression plus differentiation model
disease_comparison: Healthy nonsmokers versus healthy smokers and smokers with COPD
key_expression_result: Loss of a 134-gene distal-airway program and gain of a 233-gene proximal-airway program; illustrative distal markers included SCGB3A2, SFTPB, and LTF, with EGFR linked to proximal identity
perturbation_or_validation: EGF treatment during small-airway basal-cell differentiation reproduced proximalization
composition_interpretation: Epithelial brushing reduces whole-lung composition effects, but altered epithelial subtype proportions remain part of the signal
principal_limitations: The authors explicitly describe a smoking-dependent pattern; it must not be presented as COPD-specific or separated cleanly from smoking exposure

human_material_or_model: Bronchial-brushing small-airway epithelium from 15 COPD cases and 23 controls with similar smoking history
assay_resolution: Matched bulk DNA methylation and gene-expression arrays
disease_comparison: Former smokers with COPD versus former smokers without COPD
key_expression_result: PTEN and CSNK2A2 were hypermethylated and underexpressed; EPHX1 and CYP4F11 also showed strong inverse methylation-expression relationships; PTEN, NRF2 oxidative-stress, and IL-17F pathways were concordantly disrupted
perturbation_or_validation: Selected methylation changes were validated by pyrosequencing
composition_interpretation: Small-airway brushing is epithelial-enriched, so results are more tissue-specific than homogenized lung but still may reflect epithelial subtype proportions
principal_limitations: Array coverage was promoter-biased and association cannot establish that methylation caused expression loss

phenotype_scope: COPD onset and progression across GOLD stages
human_material_or_model: Purified primary parenchymal human lung fibroblasts
disease_comparison: No-COPD ex-smoker controls versus GOLD I and GOLD II-IV donors
key_expression_result: Six hundred twenty genes were differentially expressed in established COPD fibroblasts; altered programs involved proliferation, DNA repair, and extracellular-matrix organization, and 77 DEGs were linked by proximity to at least one DMR
evidence_class: Cell-enriched multi-omic association plus phenotypic screen
perturbation_or_validation: SiRNA screening of 110 nominated regulators measured alpha-SMA, collagen I, and proliferation phenotypes in normal and COPD fibroblasts
composition_interpretation: Purification and culture sharply reduce bulk cell-mixture confounding, so persistent differences are consistent with fibroblast-intrinsic reprogramming
principal_limitations: RNA-seq discovery groups were small and DMR-to-gene links were proximity based; siRNA hits do not prove that the paired DMR controls the phenotype

human_material_or_model: Peripheral lung parenchyma from three severe COPD transplant recipients and three nonsmoking controls
assay_resolution: Single-cell RNA-seq of 29,961 cells with whole-lung protein follow-up
disease_comparison: Severe COPD versus nondiseased nonsmoking controls
key_expression_result: Monocytes, macrophages, and ciliated epithelial cells had the most DE genes; IGFBP5 was increased in COPD ciliated cells and tracked emphysema in bulk data; QKI and IGFBP5 were validated as altered proteins
evidence_class: Observational cell-type-resolved association plus protein validation
perturbation_or_validation: Immunoblotting in an additional severe-COPD series and comparison with regional-emphysema and airflow-limitation signatures
composition_interpretation: Within-cluster DE is more consistent with cell-intrinsic change than a bulk signature, whereas reported abundance trends are separate and were not statistically significant
principal_limitations: Very small, age- and smoking-mismatched discovery groups; the paper contains discordant narrative statements about QKI protein direction, so this table does not assign a QKI direction

human_material_or_model: Explanted parenchymal lung from 17 advanced-COPD former smokers and 15 age-matched donor controls; 111,540 cells
assay_resolution: Single-cell RNA-seq with sorted-cell, tissue, mouse-smoke, and cell-model validation
key_expression_result: An HHIP-expressing AT2 subpopulation showed aberrant metabolic and antioxidant programs with lower NUPR1; general capillary endothelial cells showed increased CXCL12-centered signaling; high-metallothionein alveolar macrophages were enriched
evidence_class: Cell-state expression and abundance association with orthogonal validation
perturbation_or_validation: Sorted human alveolar epithelial RNA-seq, in situ assays, long-term smoke-exposed mice, and cell models
composition_interpretation: Lower NUPR1 and endothelial CXCL12 are within-cell-state findings; enrichment of high-metallothionein macrophages is principally an abundance/state-distribution finding
principal_limitations: All cases had advanced emphysema and transplant-level disease, limiting generalization to mild or airway-predominant COPD

phenotype_scope: COPD case-control plus disease-severity and emphysema gene sets
human_material_or_model: Homogenized lung methylation and expression profiles from LGRC, with human endothelial-cell follow-up
assay_resolution: Bulk lung multi-omics plus in vitro perturbation
key_expression_result: EPAS1 was nominated as a methylation-linked regulator; EPAS1 protein was lower in COPD lung and its predicted downstream network overlapped hypoxia- and emphysema-related programs
evidence_class: Bulk observational network inference plus gene perturbation
perturbation_or_validation: EPAS1 siRNA in human endothelial cells altered a gene set overlapping the inferred lung network
composition_interpretation: Bulk lung direction may reflect endothelial abundance as well as cell-intrinsic regulation; endothelial siRNA tests mechanism in one candidate cell type
principal_limitations: Network and methylation-expression integration are not enhancer-target proof; severity/emphysema overlap is not COPD-specific evidence

phenotype_scope: COPD case-control; epithelial-barrier and airspace-damage mechanism
human_material_or_model: Differentiated primary airway epithelial cells from normal and COPD donors; human COPD precision-cut lung slices
assay_resolution: Cell-enriched expression, locus methylation, chromatin occupancy, and ex vivo tissue response
key_expression_result: TET1 and CDH1/E-cadherin were reduced in COPD-derived epithelium while CDH1 enhancer D was hypermethylated and had reduced RNA polymerase II occupancy
perturbation_or_validation: Global 5-aza-2-prime-deoxycytidine treatment restored CDH1 and barrier measures in cells and reduced damage and airspace enlargement in human COPD slices
composition_interpretation: Persistence in differentiated donor-derived cultures supports a cell-intrinsic epithelial component
principal_limitations: Demethylation is global and the slice endpoint used only two COPD donors; the experiment does not isolate enhancer D as the sole drug target

phenotype_scope: COPD, principally emphysema and impaired alveolar repair
human_material_or_model: Whole lung and primary human alveolar type II cells; 3D lung tissue cultures
assay_resolution: Tissue and cell-enriched expression plus repair assays
key_expression_result: FZD4 expression was lower in COPD lung and primary AT2 cells, accompanying reduced canonical WNT activity
evidence_class: Disease expression plus gain- and loss-of-function mechanism
perturbation_or_validation: FZD4 inhibition impaired epithelial proliferation, wound closure, AT2-to-AT1 differentiation, and organoid formation; restoration improved WNT signaling and elastogenic programs
composition_interpretation: Primary AT2 data support an alveolar epithelial-intrinsic component, while whole-lung measurements remain composition-sensitive
principal_limitations: Best interpreted as emphysema/alveolar-repair evidence rather than a universal COPD airway program

human_material_or_model: Air-liquid-interface reconstituted bronchial epithelium from COPD and control donors; laser-microdissected airway epithelium and lung sections
assay_resolution: Epithelial-enriched targeted RNA-seq and tissue validation
disease_comparison: COPD versus nonsmoker and smoker controls
key_expression_result: Canonical WNT/beta-catenin activity was higher in COPD airway epithelium and accompanied impaired differentiation, polarity, and barrier function and increased EMT
evidence_class: Disease expression plus bidirectional pathway perturbation
perturbation_or_validation: WNT activation worsened COPD-like epithelial features, whereas inhibition increased ciliated differentiation and barrier function and reduced EMT
composition_interpretation: Persistent differences in reconstituted epithelium support cell-intrinsic airway dysregulation
principal_limitations: This airway result is compartment-specific and does not contradict lower FZD4-dependent canonical WNT repair in the COPD alveolar compartment
